period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2012. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2013 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF ('unaudited_first_quarter_financial_Statements_2013.pdf', retrieved via Wayback Machine from the bank's pre-2021 site structure) is a genuine digital/text PDF -- pdftotext -layout extracted it cleanly, no OCR needed. Fully cross-checked: balance-sheet identity closes (liabilities 23,507,078,447 + equity -8,665,769,543 = 14,841,308,904 vs reported total assets 14,841,308,902, a 2-taka rounding difference); income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D=0 this quarter, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.006, matching reported). IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY (flagged per project convention, not reconciled here -- see sources.json): this filing's own 31-Dec-2012 comparative column reports Total Shareholders' equity of BDT -8,661,933,873m, but this dataset's existing 2012_Q4.json (sourced from the FY2013 annual report's Tier-I capital/capital-adequacy note, not from a Balance Sheet) records FY2012 total_equity as BDT -9,214.82m -- a difference of almost exactly BDT 552.885m, which equals this bank's 'Other reserve' balance-sheet line (1,065,676 other reserves + 552,885,232 revaluation reserve = 553,950,908, of which the 552,885,232 revaluation-reserve component appears to be excluded from the annual report's Tier-I/regulatory-capital note but is included in the face-of-balance-sheet accounting equity used in this and all other interim filings in this dataset). Corroboration that the interim/balance-sheet figure (-8,661.93m) is the more consistent one: dividing it by 664,702,300 shares gives NAV per share of -13.03, which matches this dataset's own already-stored 2012_Q4.json nav_per_share value (-13.03) exactly; the stored total_equity of -9,214.82m would instead imply NAVPS of -13.86, inconsistent with 2012_Q4.json's own NAVPS field. This suggests 2012_Q4.json's total_equity may have been sourced from the wrong sub-total (regulatory Tier-1 capital rather than accounting equity) for FY2012-2013 specifically -- flagged here for the orchestrating session's attention; 2012_Q4.json itself is left unmodified per this task's scope.
